meta.title: Withdraw is offered on an upcoming RFQ
warnings: moved open_prepared to the front — every later step acts on that screen
moved open_prepared to the front — every later step acts on that screen

steps.note: Open the API-prepared upcoming RFQ's summary page.
Ensure eRFX projects are enabled as required for the upcoming RFQ.
Verify Withdraw is present and enabled in the RFQ Settings menu.
Select Withdraw to open its confirmation window without confirming it.
Confirm the withdrawal dialog opened and requires withdrawal remarks.
Cancel the withdrawal so the event remains unchanged.
Verify the withdrawal dialog closed after cancellation.
